metadata.name: Schema Generator
metadata.description: Generates JSON-LD structured data for Article, FAQ, Product, and other schema types
metadata.author: Adrian Goldner

input.name: schema_type
input.allowed-values: - Article - BlogPosting - FAQPage - Product - Organization - Person - BreadcrumbList

input.name: article_data
input.fields: - headline: string (required) - description: string (required) - author_name: string (required) - author_url: string (optional) - date_published: ISO-8601 date (required) - date_modified: ISO-8601 date (optional) - image_url: string (required) - publisher_name: string (required) - publisher_logo_url: string (required) - main_entity_url: string (required - the article URL) - word_count: number (optional)

input.name: faq_data
input.fields: - questions: array of objects (required) - question: string - answer: string

input.name: product_data
input.fields: - name: string (required) - description: string (required) - image_url: string (required) - price: number (required) - currency: string (required, e.g., "EUR") - availability: string (required, e.g., "InStock") - brand: string (optional) - sku: string (optional) - review_rating: number (optional, 1-5) - review_count: number (optional)

input.name: organization_data
input.fields: - name: string (required) - url: string (required) - logo_url: string (required) - description: string (optional) - social_profiles: array of strings (optional) - contact_email: string (optional) - contact_phone: string (optional)

output.name: html_script_tag
output.description: Complete HTML script tag ready to paste into head section

step.details: - Check that required fields for the selected schema type are present - Validate URLs are well-formed - Validate dates are ISO-8601 format - Return error if validation fails
- Ensure valid JSON syntax - Check all required schema.org properties are present - Validate URLs are absolute paths

usage-example.scenario: Generate Article schema for a published blog post
usage-example.code:
schema = schema_generator.run( schema_type: "Article", article_data: { headline: "10 Wege zu besseren Interviews", description: "Lerne wie du durch strukturierte Interviews besseren Content erstellst.", author_name: "Adrian Goldner", author_url: "https://example.com/about", date_published: "2025-10-22T10:00:00+00:00", image_url: "https://example.com/images/interview-guide.jpg", publisher_name: "ContentFlow Academy", publisher_logo_url: "https://example.com/logo.png", main_entity_url: "https://example.com/blog/interview-guide", word_count: 2450 } )
# Insert schema.html_script_tag into <head> section webflow.insert_to_head(schema.html_script_tag)

validator.description: Test generated schema with Google's Rich Results Test

task.notes: - Always include schema on published articles for SEO benefits - Test with Google Rich Results Test before publishing - Keep publisher_logo_url as a square image (min 112x112px) - Use specific schema types when possible (BlogPosting over Article) - Can be invoked by Content-Publisher agent before Webflow upload
